async def act(page):
    # Plan:
    # 1. Open the Catalog menu, then open Reviews and Ratings, then click Customer Reviews (the final click will navigate).
    # 2. After navigation, wait for the page to load and then count occurrences of the string "2022" in the page
    #    (this is a robust heuristic that will match review rows whose created date contains 2022).
    # 3. Print the numeric count (so the caller running this script will receive the raw number output).
    
    # Notes on knowledge base functions:
    # - get_dashboard_summary / export_dashboard_snapshot / generate_sales_summary_for_date_range
    #   are dashboard-focused helpers and do not expose review counts. They are not useful for this task,
    #   so we do not call them.
    
    # Click the Catalog top-level link (this usually opens the submenu in Magento admin)
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Catalog").click()
    # small pause to let submenu open
    await page.wait_for_timeout(500)

    # Click the Reviews and Ratings submenu (may reveal deeper submenu)
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Reviews and Ratings").click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(300)

    # Final navigation: click Customer Reviews (this should navigate away from the dashboard)
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Customer Reviews").click()

    # Wait for navigation / network idle so the reviews grid loads
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(700)

    # Count occurrences of "2022" on the page. This counts the number of cells/places where 2022 appears
    # (typically the Created Date column in the reviews grid). We use an accessible text locator.
    count = await page.get_by_text("2022").count()

    # Print the result exactly as retrieved (raw numeric count)
    print(count)
